frase_gancho.texto: The first Americans crossed a world of ice.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: From the question of who we are, we move on to another: how did we get here? This hall tells the journey of small groups of hunter-gatherers who, tens of thousands of years ago, crossed from Asia by way of Beringia, a frozen land that now lies beneath the sea, and gradually settled the entire continent. You will see what the Pleistocene world was like, with mammoths, bison and giant sloths, and how a changing climate forced them to invent another way of life: gathering seeds, hunting small animals and, at the end of the hall, planting crops. Along the way, three objects and several murals tell, in stone and in bone, how Mexico became possible.
